# Grove conformance fixtures

Copied unchanged from [grove-fhir](https://github.com/SchmiedmayerLab/grove-fhir) at commit `e04ab868401faa8984105e09b3077336519a0ef9` (Grove 0.6.0), the revision the registry is generated from. `exchange-protocol-excerpt.json` holds the test vectors, entry identity, reference policy, lifecycle and event sections of `catalog/exchange-protocol.json`.
